visuals.purpose: Stage the Gauntlet as a research control interface: task nodes route selectively toward five specialist Gems and converge on a typed receipt core.
visuals.design_reference_boundary: Original Gauntlet artwork. It transfers focal-object staging, constellation/node formation, reveal/beam grammar, and progressive power legibility observed in the user's Tribunal and Card Game interface references; it copies no external imagery and imports no reference runtime.
visuals.boundary: Conceptual control-interface illustration; it is not an execution trace, capability measurement, or behavioral-efficacy result.

visuals.purpose: Demonstrate selective routing on one example research goal: obligation nodes activate Space, Reality, Power and Time while Mind remains explicitly on standby because no formal proof is load-bearing.
visuals.boundary: Illustrative routing example derived from module contracts; it does not claim this exact route is chosen for every similar prompt and it is not behavioral evidence.
